Metadata.title: Dubai Communicates in Emirati Sign Language
Metadata.description: A forward-thinking initiative from the Community Development Authority, designed to build a more inclusive and connected society through Emirati Sign Language.

hero.subtitle: Dubai Communicates in Emirati Sign Language is a forward-thinking initiative from the Community Development Authority, designed to build a more inclusive and connected society. Our mission is to empower the community with Emirati Sign Language, breaking down communication barriers and ensuring every individual, including People of Determination, can engage fully in our city's vibrant life. This initiative provides the tools and opportunities to foster direct, meaningful communication across all segments of society.

about.label: About
about.description1: We are creating a Dubai where communication is seamless and accessible to everyone. Our goal is a society where Emirati Sign Language is widely understood and used, enhancing daily interactions and creating new opportunities for connection.
about.description2: This vision is built on a foundation of respect for diversity and a commitment to improving the quality of life for all residents.

mission.label: Vision
mission.title: Our Strategic Mission
mission.description: The Dubai Communicates in Emirati Sign Language initiative is a commitment to progress, built on four powerful pillars:
mission.pillar1Desc: By advancing the goals of the Dubai Social Agenda 33, this initiative cements Dubai's role as a global leader in social innovation and support for People of Determination.
mission.pillar2Desc: We offer a unified virtual lesson led by experts from the Deaf community, ensuring authentic, high-quality instruction in Emirati Sign Language.
mission.pillar3Desc: We are aiming to set a Guinness World Record for the largest virtual sign language lesson. This monumental event will amplify our message of inclusion on a global scale.
mission.pillar4Desc: This initiative unites government bodies, private sector partners, and educational institutions in a powerful collaboration to drive lasting and widespread impact.

missionCards.card1Desc: We are creating a Dubai where communication is seamless and accessible to everyone. Our goal is a society where Emirati Sign Language is widely understood and used, enhancing daily interactions and creating new opportunities for connection. This vision is built on a foundation of respect for diversity and a commitment to improving the quality of life for all residents.
missionCards.card2Desc: Sign language is a complete and effective communication system. It is a visual language that conveys complex ideas and nuances with clarity and precision. By enabling direct communication without reliance on sound, sign language fosters genuine understanding and strengthens connections between people. It is a vital tool for building a truly inclusive environment.
